subject: Your 30-second fix for quiet audio
preview_text: One tap, instant clarity. No more cranking volume to 100%.
body_paragraphs: You know that moment on the train when you turn your phone up to max and still can't hear the podcast over the rumble? That's what Loud EQ kills in one tap.

I built this for myself at 2AM after a commute where I missed half an audiobook. The fix isn't more volume—it's smarter volume. Loud EQ's Optimize feature tunes your audio around your exact headphones in seconds.
Open the app, tap the Optimize button, and plug in your earbuds. That's it. You'll hear dialog clearly, even at low volume. No distortion. No speaker risk. Just clean, loud sound.
Try it now. It takes 30 seconds. P.S. Premium unlocks the full +200% boost and keeps your ears safe with a hearing streak—but the Optimize button works free.
